milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the purple wall banner on the building's west exterior and face it to confirm visual identification. Target is at spawn-relative (3, 2, 5) with max_distance=8 to allow the player to see it from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 to confirm they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the 'interact' task requires the player to approach and face the blast furnace (at spawn-relative 5, 0, 5) to right-click it. The player must be within 3 blocks and facing it. This is preferred over use_item since use_item tracking for blast_furnace may not be reliably captured in all MineRL implementations, while proximity+facing confirms the player is in position to interact.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because red stained glass panes drop NOTHING when mined without Silk Touch (CommonSenseAgent confirmed this), so inventory_has cannot be used. Instead, we check that at least one glass pane block has been removed from the barrier wall at x=7, z=6-8, y=0-2. The box covers the glass pane wall area. If fewer than 9 glass pane blocks remain (originally 9 placed in a 1x3x3 pattern), at least one was mined.

Uses inventory_has because acquiring treasure means the player takes items from the chest into their inventory. The chest contains 3 diamonds and 5 gold ingots. Checking for at least 1 diamond confirms the player successfully opened the chest and looted it. The player starts with no diamonds, so any diamond in inventory must come from the chest.
